info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Search and Recommendations API

params.name: customerKey
params.description: The customer key identifying the Sitecore Discover account. Found in the Customer Engagement Console under Developer Resources > API Access.

params.name: key
params.description: URL-encoded JSON object containing the search query parameters including keyword, widget ID, page context, and filter facets

items.docs: Performs a product or content search and retrieves ranked results with optional faceted filtering and personalized recommendations. Supports keyword search, category browsing, and recommendation widget contexts. The key parameter contains a JSON string with all query parameters.

params.name: customerKey
params.description: The customer key identifying the Sitecore Discover account. Found in the Customer Engagement Console under Developer Resources > API Access.

items.docs: Performs a product or content search using a POST request body instead of query parameters. Supports the same functionality as the GET endpoint with the query parameters provided as a JSON request body.
